description: Map a ticker, ISIN, CUSIP, SEDOL or FIGI to one security through OpenFIGI: its name, FIGIs, listings, exchange and type. Check digits are tested first, so a mistyped ISIN or CUSIP is refused.

exchange.description: OpenFIGI's exchange code, for a ticker: US (default), LN, GR, JP, HK...

id.description: A ticker, ISIN, CUSIP, SEDOL or FIGI; the kind is read from its form.

name: security_identifiers

outputSchema.description: rows are listings of the security in the order of columns

title: Security identifiers (OpenFIGI)
